# The www redirect refused in connected mode on retail UO 1.51b,
# 2026-10-20: the same setup as www-chkfail-15.txt under COD_VERSION=uo
# (sv_wwwDlDisconnected 0 on the command line; the homepath config's 1 is
# overridden). One HTTP GET. After `wwwdl chkfail` the server resent the
# gamestate and redirected the re-request again (one message with nothing,
# then the redirect: the two `begining` lines); vcod's client acked it and
# refused it with `wwwdl fail` (the name on its bad-checksum list), the
# server resent the gamestate, redirected the next request again, and the
# client left. No block went over UDP. Gate: www_download.rs
# a_refused_redirect_on_uo_is_redirected_again_until_the_client_leaves.
